prediction.closure: General free-streaming Maxwell radiation; universal perfect-fluid screen closure formally excluded
prediction.novelty_scope: The formula existed as a conditional TGL-S candidate. What is newly derived here is the general Maxwell radiation selection. The prospective test uses only future data; this is not represented as a historically unprecedented formula.

primary_analysis.data_requirement: First CMB-HD cosmology dataset frozen after this protocol; no CMB-HD measurement used to select the prediction or rule

reference_partition.low_multipoles_and_BB: SO/ASO-like reference inputs as in the forecast; actual substitutions require a dated amendment before unblinding
reference_partition.external_break_degeneracy: DESI BAO with its actual covariance; no diagonal approximation

primary_analysis.model: Flat LCDM + N_eff + sum_mnu reference comparison, with the TGL implementation using one and only one beta insertion and no double counting
primary_analysis.covariance: Full TT/TE/EE/BB/kappa-kappa covariance, including non-Gaussian lensing terms and simulation-based small-scale covariance where required
primary_analysis.foregrounds: Frequency-separated residual foreground model with realistic end-to-end simulations; failure to validate the required residuals yields INCONCLUSIVE_SYSTEMATICS
primary_analysis.delensing: Iterative delensing with lensing covariance retained; unvalidated bias mitigation yields INCONCLUSIVE_SYSTEMATICS
primary_analysis.baryons: Marginalize baryonic effects and use CMB-HD tSZ/kSZ information; neglected baryonic bias is not acceptable
primary_analysis.blinding: Freeze likelihood, covariance, parameter transforms and all amendment hashes before revealing N_eff centers; validate on simulations and cosmology-independent null tests

independent_replication.data_requirement: New SO data not used to choose beta, N_SM, the closure, the center or this decision rule
independent_replication.independence: Different facility and independently released likelihood/data products from CMB-HD; shared Planck/DESI inputs require explicit cross-covariance or disjoint partitions
independent_replication.reference_forecast: sigma(N_eff) approximately 0.045 for the fully populated receiver over the planned survey; this is lower-powered corroboration, not an independent 5-sigma claim
independent_replication.replication_rule: Delta_N_eff_estimate > 0, |N_eff_SO - 3.1634660752537313413| / sigma_SO_total <= 2, and no failed systematics/null-test gate

decision_rule.sigma_total: sqrt(sigma_stat^2 + sigma_systematic^2 + sigma_foreground^2 + sigma_delensing^2 + sigma_theory_implementation^2), avoiding any double counting
decision_rule.global_separation: A joint HD+SO analysis with explicit cross-covariance must give (N_eff_joint - N_SM) / sigma_joint_total >= 5
decision_rule.matched_prospectively: Require primary_match, primary_separation, independent_replication.replication_rule, global_separation, and all validation gates
decision_rule.falsified: Require two genuinely independent experiments each at least 5 sigma away from N_eff_TGL, as in the earlier kill rule; a single tension is not called falsification
decision_rule.underpowered: Report NOT_FALSIFIED_UNDERPOWERED when the design sensitivity cannot decide; never convert absence of significance into evidence for TGL
